temple.name: TEMPLE OF TIME
temple.arrival: The noise of the market falls away beneath the vault. Three hollows mark the altar before an unbroken stone door.

escape.speaker: Navi
escape.line: The gates! Impa is taking Zelda out of the castle. Something is terribly wrong.

escape.speaker: Zelda
escape.line: Link! Remember the Temple of Time!

escape.speaker: Ganondorf
escape.line: A girl on a white horse passed this way. You would stand against me? Remember who rules this kingdom.

echo.speaker: Zelda's memory
echo.line: If this melody reaches you, I could not wait at the castle. I have left you the Ocarina of Time. Take the three Spiritual Stones to the temple in the town.

echo.speaker: Song of Time
echo.line: Right, A, down; right, A, down. Place the stones upon the altar, then play the melody before the Door of Time. Its seal will answer.

altar: Three hollows: forest, fire and water. The inscription asks for the royal instrument and the song that carries its name. E places the three Spiritual Stones; 1 begins a melody.
door: Stone slides against stone. Beyond the altar, a sword waits in a shaft of pale light.
sword: The Master Sword rests in the pedestal. The sacred blade is the final seal on the entrance to the Sacred Realm.

awakening.speaker: Rauru
awakening.line: Seven years have passed while the sacred blade kept you here. Ganondorf entered the Sacred Realm and seized its power. Hyrule outside these walls has changed.

awakening.speaker: Rauru
awakening.line: I am the Sage of Light. The other sages must awaken in their temples. Take the Light Medallion and return to the world that needs you.

awakening.speaker: Sheik
awakening.line: The forest is calling. Saria waits beyond the Sacred Forest Meadow. Find the tool that carries you across a chasm in Kakariko's graveyard, then seek the Forest Temple.

sages.name: CHAMBER OF SAGES
sages.arrival: A circle of stone hangs in the quiet of the Sacred Realm. Rauru waits across the seal.

time_backward.speaker: The pedestal of time
time_backward.line: The blade returns to the stone. Seven years fall away; the kingdom of your childhood is within reach again.

time_forward.speaker: The pedestal of time
time_forward.line: The Master Sword leaves the stone. The kingdom seven years ahead calls you back.

prelude: The forest's sage has awakened. The Master Sword can now join your childhood to this age: return it to the pedestal to go back, and draw it to come forward. Remember this song whenever the road is long: I L I L U I. The Prelude of Light brings you to this sanctuary.
